claims.text: Regime: pairs of knob edits in both orders, RTX 4060, original output, 500 steps per edit, at the training learning rate. A knob moves one existing weight of a source network by 1 and changes a visible part of its image. With source pb the targets are renders of the Picbreeder network, so it reaches them exactly by moving those weights, which favours Picbreeder by construction. PBd has every weight free, PBa only its existing edges, G0 is fully fitted dense networks. The Picbreeder rows of a task come from one network, so these describe that network. Informed by every earlier test, so not blind. Claim: on its own knobs PBd is left with at most half the error of G0 after an edit; >= 1 falsifies.
